title: RabbitMQ.Client
description: The official .NET client library for RabbitMQ message broker.

data.text: RabbitMQ.Client is the official .NET client for RabbitMQ. It provides full access to the AMQP 0-9-1 protocol, enabling fine-grained control over exchanges, queues, and message routing.

data.title: Sending and Receiving
data.content: Publish and consume messages with RabbitMQ.

terms.definition: A routing mechanism that receives messages from producers and routes them to queues.
A buffer that stores messages until they are consumed.
A relationship between an exchange and a queue.

data.title: Warning
data.text: Always handle connection and channel exceptions. RabbitMQ connections can be lost due to network issues.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Use RabbitMQ.Client when you need full control over AMQP messaging.
